title: Pokemon Altaria GX 061/096 RR SM7 Sky-Splitting Charisma Japanese Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
Pokemon Japanese - Altaria GX (チルタリスGX) 061/096 RR
SM7 Sky-Splitting Charisma (裂空のカリスマ), 2018
Ultra Rare / Double Rare holo GX. Illustrated by 5ban Graphics.

Stage 1, HP 200, Dragon type.
 Bright Tone (50) - during your opponent's next turn, this Pokemon takes no damage from attacks by Pokemon GX and EX.
 Sonic Edge (110) - this attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokemon.
 Euphoria GX - your opponent's Active Pokemon is now Asleep. Heal all damage from all of your Pokemon.

Ungraded, near mint or better. The exact card pictured is the card you will receive. Shipped in a sleeve and toploader.
